summary: In tests from a small computer model rather than studies on people, Sulfisoxazole Acetyl received a high score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M]. A similar drug called Sulfacarbamide was pulled from the market in Germany for causing liver damage and blood-related harm [3]. Another related medicine, Sulfamethazine, was also removed from the market in Germany [4]. Additionally, a human study involving this drug was stopped early because of low patient sign-ups and not having enough staff [6].
